name: WNTI National Fish Habitat Partnership funding

funder.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (National Fish Habitat Partnership program)

summary: Annual National Fish Habitat Partnership funding for locally led, on-the-ground projects that protect and restore habitat for 21 western native trout and char species. Typical awards are $25k-$50k with a 1:1 match.

geography.label: Western United States, historic range of western native trout

deadline.text: 5:00 p.m. Mountain time on Friday October 16, 2026

status.quote: Applications to WNTI are due in our online portal by 5:00 p.m. Mountain time on Friday October 16, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications to WNTI are due in our online portal by 5:00 p.m. Mountain time on Friday October 16, 2026.

geography.quote: WNTI is a collaborative effort between 12 western states, three federal agencies, sovereign tribes, private businesses and individuals, non-governmental conservation groups, and other organizations that seek to cooperatively conserve (protect, restore, enhance, and recover) 21 western native trout and char species and sub-species across their historic range.

access.quote: All applications for WNTI's RFP are submitted through our online application portal.

window.quote: project funding through this RFP is made available to grantees annually through the National Fish Habitat Partnership (NFHP) program

amount.quote: Typical funding per project is in the range of $25K-$50K.

co_finance_required.quote: Successful proposals must demonstrate a minimum 1:1 NFHP:non-federal match

administered_by.quote: NFHP funds are federal funds, administered through the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS).
